NTDC/CS/500kV/2026/07.content: Instructions to Bidders - 500kV GIS Substation Mardan Expansion (Ref: NTDC/CS/500kV/2026/07). Scope: Design, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of 500kV GIS substation expansion including 500kV bays, 2x750/1000 MVA autotransformers, protection and SCADA integration. Contract type: EPC/Turnkey under FIDIC Silver Book conditions of contract (1999 edition). Eligibility: PEC licence category C-A No Limit required. The bidder shall have average annual turnover of at least PKR 3,000,000,000 for the last three financial years, audited by a chartered accountant. The bidder must have successfully completed at least 3 similar nature works of 500kV substations or above. Joint ventures with foreign firms are permitted subject to PEC JV regulations and submission of the JV agreement. Bid security: PKR 90,000,000 in the form of an irrevocable bank guarantee from a scheduled bank, valid 28 days beyond bid validity. Submission deadline: 20-Nov-2026, 14:00 hours through EPMS e-procurement portal. Two envelope single stage procedure. Prices: firm and fixed; no price adjustment except variations under the contract. Advance payment: mobilization advance of 10 percent against bank guarantee is allowed; no other advance without guarantee. Liquidated damages: delay damages at 0.05 percent of contract price per day capped at 10 percent. Liability: the contractor's aggregate liability shall be without limitation for all losses arising from the works. Design responsibility: contractor shall carry out detailed design, geotechnical investigation, earthing and protection studies at its own cost and risk. Insurance: CAR and third party liability insurance to be maintained throughout the contract. Dispute resolution: disputes shall be referred to international arbitration under ICC rules with the seat of arbitration in Singapore.

General Conditions - FIDIC Silver Book (EPC/Turnkey) with Particular Conditions for NTDC Mardan 500kV expansion. Sub-Clause 4.12: Contractor takes responsibility for adverse physical conditions to the extent stated in the contract data. Sub-Clause 8.7: Delay damages as stated in the contract data. Sub-Clause 13.8: Adjustments for changes in laws and cost fluctuation are not applicable; the contract price is firm. Sub-Clause 17.6: Limitation of liability: no limitation of liability applies to the contractor's obligations. Sub-Clause 20.2: ICC arbitration, seat Singapore, language English. Particular Conditions modify Sub-Clause 14.2: 10 percent advance against an advance payment guarantee. Site access at Mardan grid station available on the commencement date stated in the contract data.

Priced schedule of rates and bill of quantities - 500kV GIS Mardan expansion. Section 1: GIS bay extension and busbar works. Section 2: Autotransformers 2x750/1000 MVA. Section 3: Protection, control and SCADA. Section 4: Civil works including GIS building extension. Section 5: Testing and commissioning, type tests. Bid security instrument details and performance security as per conditions.

NTDC/CS/220kV/2026/11.content: Instructions to Bidders - OPGW, hardware and stringing services for 220kV D/C line Jhelum-Mardan (Ref: NTDC/CS/220kV/2026/11). Scope: supply of OPGW and conductor hardware and stringing services for approximately 60 km of 220kV double circuit line. Eligibility: PEC licence C-B or above; bidders must have completed at least 2 similar nature works of 220kV transmission lines and stringing in the last ten years. Bid security: PKR 23,600,000 in the form of deposit at call or bank guarantee. Bid security form: bank guarantee preferred. Submission deadline: 12-Nov-2026 at 11:00 hours. Single stage one envelope. Liquidated damages for delay 0.05 percent per day capped at 10 percent. Price firm without adjustment. Two stage two envelope process is not applicable; single stage one envelope applies.

FED/PWD/2026/CS-88.content: Request for Proposals - Feasibility study and detailed design of transmission corridor reinforcement (Ref: FED/PWD/2026/CS-88). Consulting services required for power system studies, route survey and detailed design. Evaluation on quality and cost based selection (QCBS). Bid security not applicable for consultancy services; proposal security of PKR 1,700,000 in the form of bank guarantee required. Submission deadline: 02-Nov-2026. Firms shall be registered with PEC in relevant category for consultancy. Two stage two envelope: technical and financial proposals.
